content: The title of the screening page should be formatted as (Disease name) screening, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The purpose of the page is to describe the methods used to screen for the disease in question. At the top of the edit box, include the following elements: the {{CMG}} template, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template that you created earlier. When creating links within WikiDoc, enclose key terms in brackets to link them to other relevant pages. Ensure that the links are as specific as possible. For instance, if a sentence includes the term anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to the page for anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For further guidance on creating links, click here. Follow the formatting and capitalization guidelines as outlined in the provided template. The name of the disease should be included in the first sentence of every subsection. The overview section must include the name of the disease in the first sentence. The goal of the overview section is to summarize the screening page in a few sentences. This section can be identical to the screening segment found on the overview page. For an example of an overview section on a symptoms page, click here. Template for Writing First Sentence: Examples: Additional Sentence: Examples: Preferred Template Statements If no guidelines exist to support the benefit of screening: There is insufficient evidence to recommend routine screening for [disease]. If screening is explicitly not recommended: According to [source], screening for [disease] is not recommended. If screening is recommended by a reputable source: According to [source], screening for [disease] is recommended every [time interval] among patients with [specific risk factors]. Screening Section This section may include subheadings to describe the various screening methods and the efficacy of each method. For an example of a screening subsection with subheadings within a screening page, click here.
